description: Once home to the Frenchman Charles Lopinot, who was a key figure in the development of this area, Lopinot Village tells the story of the French settlers and enslaved Africans who shaped Trinidad’s diverse heritage. The estate’s picturesque architecture and lush surroundings create the perfect setting for visitors to explore. The Complex is known for the Cocoa House, its Bridge and scenic trails. Listed opening hours: 6:00AM - 6:00PM. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
